outputRoot.description: Path prefix prepended to every x-kotlin-source path before emission. Defaults to '.' so paths in the spec land at the forge output dir root.

missingExtensionPolicy.description: What to do when a user-facing schema has no x-kotlin-source annotation. 'error' (default) fails generation with a single diagnostic listing every un-annotated type. 'warn' emits a per-type warning and skips it — designed for incremental rollout of x-kotlin-source across a large spec.
